name: creer
description: AI-powered repo scaffolding inside your workspace

creer.initGit.description: Initialize a git repo after scaffolding

creer.githubToken.description: DEPRECATED: Prefer SecretStorage via 'Creer: Set GitHub Token'. Used only as a fallback when SecretStorage is empty.
creer.githubToken.deprecationMessage: Use 'Creer: Set GitHub Token' (SecretStorage) instead of storing the token in settings.

creer.createGitHubRepo.description: After scaffolding, create a GitHub remote repository

creer.previewBeforeWrite.description: Show a plan preview and confirm before generating and writing files

creer.useStreaming.description: Use SSE streaming (/generate/stream) with per-file progress; falls back to /generate on failure

creer.ciPreset.description: CI workflow bake-in preset for generated projects

creer.promptBakeins.description: When true, QuickPick license and CI each run; when false, use creer.license and creer.ciPreset

creer.contentPreview.description: After generate, before write, show a content preview/diff and confirm

creer.showConflictDiffs.description: When conflicts exist, offer Review diffs (side-by-side vscode.diff). When false, only Overwrite all / Skip existing / Cancel

creer.defaultWorkspaceFolder.description: Optional workspace folder name or path hint for multi-root workspaces; empty prompts when multiple folders are open

creer.registryPeers.description: Comma-separated peer base URLs used when browsing the federated registry (passed as peers= query)

creer.showPeerStatus.description: When browsing the federated registry, show peer health summary (ok/fail/latency)

creer.federatedDiscover.description: When browsing the federated registry, pass discover=true for one-hop peer expansion

creer.federationMaxHops.description: Max peer-discovery hops for federated browse (sent as max_hops when the backend supports it). 0 = configured peers only; 1 = one hop; 2 = two hops.

creer.warnPrivatePeers.description: Warn before adding or probing peers whose host looks like localhost or a private IP

creer.requireSignedPeers.description: When true, hide federated packs from peers whose trust_status is unsigned, invalid, or skipped (local packs always kept). Uses client-side filtering of peer_meta trust_status from the federated response.

creer.registryToken.description: DEPRECATED: Prefer SecretStorage via 'Creer: Set Registry Token'. Used only as a fallback when SecretStorage is empty. Sent as Bearer / X-Creer-Token on mutating registry requests when the backend has CREER_REGISTRY_TOKEN.
creer.registryToken.deprecationMessage: Use 'Creer: Set Registry Token' (SecretStorage) instead of storing the token in settings.

scripts.publish:ovsx: echo "Set OVSX_PAT then run: npx --yes ovsx publish" && exit 1
scripts.publish:marketplace: echo "Set VSCE_PAT then run: npx --yes @vscode/vsce publish" && exit 1
